newsitem.title: POLAND: Creditanstalt to launch CPs in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Creditanstalt to launch CPs in Poland.

text.p: Creditanstalt Securities SA said on Wednesday it would launch a commercial papers programme worth 100 million zlotys for Polish leasing firm CA-Leasing Polska sp z o.o., the brokerage's first such operation in Poland.

Creditanstalt Securities' president Wolfgang Bauer told a news conference the three-year programme of between seven and 364 days CPs with par value of 100,000 zlotys, would be arranged in tranches, beginning in January next year.
"It is the first commercial papers programme, which we are arranging after receiving a respective licence from the Polish Securities Commission (KPW)," he said.
Creditanstalt Securities, a Polish unit of Austria's Creditanstalt BV, was granted the KPW licence in July.
The issue price of the CPs papers would be set at a discount, through a tender.

CA-Leasing Polska is 50-percent owned by CA-Leasing GmbH in Vienna and Creditanstalt bank in Warsaw. Last year it had revenues of 1.9 million zlotys and expects them to jump 10 million zlotys this year.
